therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: mood stabilization via ion channel modulation, valproate-mediated HDAC/GABA modulation, and dopamine/serotonin receptor antagonism
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: reduction of manic symptoms in bipolar disorder
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: children and adolescents with bipolar disorder (mania)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Clinical Global Impressions-Bipolar Mania Improvement at Week 8

results.effect_size: CGI-BP Mania Improvement mean scores: Lithium 2.49, Divalproex 2.73, Risperidone 1.70 (lower = more improved)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Blood levels titrated to therapeutic ranges: Lithium 1.1–1.3 mEq/L, Valproate 111–125 ug/mL
biomarker_changes: Lithium blood level titrated to 1.1–1.3 mEq/L
Valproate blood level titrated to 111–125 ug/mL
K-SADS Mania Rating Scale at Week 8: Lithium 24.06, Divalproex 26.31, Risperidone 14.58
safety_signals: Modified Side Effects Form mean scores at Week 8: Lithium 5.11, Divalproex 4.95, Risperidone 3.70
Serious adverse events (hospitalization): Lithium 5/137, Divalproex 4/139, Risperidone 5/103
Event requiring intervention to prevent permanent impairment: Lithium 1/137

dose_info.dose: Lithium: titrated to blood level 1.1–1.3 mEq/L; Valproate: titrated to blood level 111–125 ug/mL; Risperidone: 2.0–3.0 mg BID
dose_info.schedule: Risperidone BID; Lithium and Valproate titrated
dose_info.dose_modifications: Titrated by weight for risperidone; titrated to blood levels for lithium and valproate

adverse_events.term: Event requiring intervention to prevent permanent impairment or damage

context.indication: Bipolar disorder (mania) in children and adolescents
context.comparator: Active comparator (three-arm: lithium vs. valproate vs. risperidone)
context.duration: 8 weeks (primary endpoint); study ran February 2003 to December 2008
